purpose: T54.3 per-release event inventory: the kinds each release ADDS (from the task DoDs of docs/wf/sources/04-TASKS.vi.md), their class, and the releases that add no kind (with the reason and the regression flow that must still run). release_check compares the OBSERVED kinds of the release's installed behaviour scenarios against this table; the producer cannot choose what to compare.

R05.note: decision.hold / decision.defer are reserved class-B names in compat.CLASS_B with NO writer in the product (25/10 audit): the W26 rule decisions (SKIP/DEFER/REVIEW/HOLD) are recorded through decision.recorded (class A, R00). They are therefore not in the inventory; listing them would demand an event nothing writes.

R07.none_reason: W50a/W50b add no event kind: issue lookup and image fallback are read paths over the existing ledger and evidence (04-TASKS W50a/W50b).
R07.regression: localization lookup + explicit map + image fallback on the installed build

RP.none_reason: W43 pins provider/model in the contract and reuses plan.advised / verdict.recorded (class 0); the real six cells are W45 evidence, not events.
RP.regression: contract lint accepts the provider fields; reviewer and advisor run through a LOCAL fake CLI on the installed build with provider/model in the receipt

RX2.none_reason: W39 data/ops adapters reuse the verdict lifecycle (verdict.receipt_issued / verdict.recorded / milestone.*) and add no kind.
RX2.regression: data and ops roots run end to end from the installed build (tests.wf_installed_adapters)
